label: Philips Hue
notes: Bridge and lightstrips hold value best. Regex requires a Hue product noun so the colour word does not match.

label: Inovelli / smart switch
notes: Inovelli rarely hits liquidation; Zooz/Caseta are the realistic equivalents.

label: ANC headphones (XM4 class)
notes: XM4 or equivalent. px7 was matching IPX7 waterproof ratings until anchored.

label: Pebble watch
notes: Pebble as a material word is everywhere - regex requires a product noun. Core Devices makes the 2025 relaunch.

label: Ubiquiti / UniFi
notes: AP or switch. U7/E7 are the WiFi 7 line and the priority.

label: AR / VR glasses
match_regex: (meta quest|oculus|quest [23]|\mxreal\M|\mnreal\M|rokid|viture|valve index|htc vive|vision pro|\mar glasses\M|\mvr headset\M)
notes: Xreal/Viture display glasses and Quest headsets both qualify.

label: Mini PC (Intel QuickSync)
notes: Best Jellyfin transcode path. 8th-gen+ Intel iGPU has QuickSync; prefer over AMD.

label: Mini PC (AMD / other)
notes: Works for Jellyfin via VAAPI but less well supported than QuickSync. 680M+ has AV1 decode.

label: Rack PDU / UPS (Ubiquiti)
notes: Rack power for the homelab - Ubiquiti USP-PDU-Pro / SmartPower, or any rack-mount UPS. NOT a phone power bank; that was a misread and matched Dyson packs and hand warmers.

label: NAS / drive enclosure
notes: For Immich/Jellyfin bulk storage. Diskless is fine.

label: HDD / SSD
notes: TITLE ONLY. Watch for fake capacity - the 64TB Hard disik listings are counterfeit.

label: E-reader / e-ink
notes: TITLE ONLY - descriptions say "compatible with e-readers" constantly.

label: Homelab rack / UPS
match_regex: (managed switch|poe switch|\mmikrotik\M|server cabinet|rack ?mount|patch panel|\mups\M battery backup|uninterruptible)
notes: Wall-mount server cabinets went for $1-2 in the first sweep.

label: Monitor 27in+ / ultrawide
notes: TITLE ONLY. Needs a size token AND the word monitor - bare digits matched blood pressure monitors.

label: HVAC tools & controls
notes: Thin bidder pool at general liquidation. VOGTEN 4.5CFM pump sat at $0 while DeWalt drills drew 33 bids.

label: Test & measurement
notes: Same thesis as HVAC - trade gear nobody in the room recognises.

label: Smart thermostat
notes: Small, high value density, easy to ship. Common in returns lots.

label: WiFi 7 AP / router (any brand)
notes: Any WiFi 7 AP or router qualifies per user. BE#### is the standard naming (BE9300, BE19000).
